systems.platform: Application built in-house by REGIDESO's own IT staff
systems.owner: REGIDESO (the state water utility); data to be shared with the Ville de Kinshasa under the convention of 24 April 2026, through a technical commission chaired by the Agence pour le Développement du Numérique
systems.tiers: City-province of Kinshasa (the provincial executive), for property tax, rental-income tax and sanitation tax; extension to other provinces and the national level agreed for a second phase
REGIDESO's payment platform; its director general says it could help the Ville de Kinshasa collect its revenue

note: A data-sharing and tax-collection convention between the provincial executive of Kinshasa and the water utility: upper-tier platforms, and nothing stated about a connection at any commune's office.
